SUBJECT: MN25112 EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE
TIME: 02 HOURS  FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Distinguish between emotions and feelings. [2] 1 1
Q.1(b) List the key elements of Emotional Intelligence (EI). [3] 1 1


Q.2(a) Identify the different techniques you can use to improve your level of self-awareness. [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Outline the historical development of EI as a field of study. [3] 1 1


Q.3(a) Discuss the trait-based model of EI. [2] 2 2
Q.3(b) Provide a detailed explanation of the ability model of EI. [3] 2 2


Q.4(a) List the different applications of the ability-based model of EI. [2] 2 3
Q.4(b) Identify the various domains in which the mixed model of EI can be applied. [3] 2 3


Q.5(a) How do you respond when faced with high-pressure or stressful conditions? [2] 3 3
Q.5(b) You are a project manager at a tech company, overseeing a team working under a
strict deadline. As the pressure increases, team members start to lose their composure
— there are communication breakdowns, conflicts, and finger-pointing over delays. In
such a situation, how would you handle it as the project manager?
[3] 3 3
